description: Defines internal civil time structures, normalization, and utility functions for date/time calculations within the Abseil C++ library, including fields for year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and functions for normalization, difference calculation, and weekday determination.

classes.name: fields
classes.description: Struct representing normalized civil-time fields: year, month, day, hour, minute, second.

classes.name: civil_time
classes.description: Template class representing civil time with different alignments (year, month, day, hour, minute, second).

methods.name: is_leap_year
methods.description: Checks if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: n_day
methods.description: Normalizes date fields without overflow, returning a 'fields' struct.

methods.name: difference
methods.description: Calculates difference between two date fields in specified units.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Increments or decrements date fields by a specified amount.

methods.name: get_weekday
methods.description: Calculates the weekday for a given civil_second.
